text: Kivuguto is spontaneously acidified by flora from the utensils and the cattle environment; modern dairies in Rwanda use imported strains instead. In consistency and flavour it is closest to Swedish filmjölk.

links.name: Karenzi et al. 2013, Biotechnol. Agron. Soc. Environ. 17(2)

adds.vessel: wooden jar (icyansi) or calabash, smoked with dried grass stems and Combretum molle; not airtight

processing.text: Traditionally soured spontaneously by flora from the utensils and the cattle environment (about 36 h in smoked jars); some makers back-slop or boil and cool the milk first, and modern Rwandan dairies use imported strains. A starter trial reached pH 4.6 in 8 h at 30 °C with L. lactis.
